claims.text: The bureau-hosted account distinguishes earlier Yanjing administration, renaming and palace construction; its author and publication year remain unresolved. The Nanjing accounts describe Jiankang’s prefectural/military offices and later palace occupation. Completion of principal imperial buildings is not the later 1283 city completion or royal move. Name, construction and occupation do not establish simultaneous identical government or empty land.
